faq.q: What is the cheapest social media management in the UK?
faq.a: Productised plans start at about £59 to £129 a month. Some freelancers charge less, but check how many posts, platforms and replies are included.

faq.q: Is £99 a month enough for social media management?
faq.a: It can cover basic posting on one or two platforms. Engagement, reporting and extra platforms are often charged on top, so compare the total.

faq.q: Do social media packages include VAT?
faq.a: Not always. Several UK agencies publish prices plus VAT, so check before comparing.

faq.q: Should a small business pay for social media management or do it themselves?
faq.a: If you post consistently yourself, DIY is fine. If posting keeps slipping, a low-cost managed plan usually pays for itself in time saved.

faq.q: Can I try social media management before committing?
faq.a: Some providers offer trials. The ContentFellow Social Fellow has a free 7-day trial with no card needed.
